frontmatter.title: The Need to Upgrade: Node.js 16 End-of-Life Moved to September 11, 2023
frontmatter.subheading: Navigating the Waters as Node.js 16 Faces an Early End-of-Life Date
frontmatter.excerpt: Node.js 16 is heading towards an early end-of-life due to its dependency on OpenSSL 1.1.1. Learn how to plan your upgrade path and ensure that your web development projects remain secure and effective.
frontmatter.author: Paul Serban
